description: Python module. schedule_scan(server_id, priority=0.5) writes to mesh_memory via write_service /write with memory_type=scan_request. get_pending_scans(limit=20) queries mesh_memory WHERE memory_type=scan_request via write_service /query. mark_scan_complete(server_id) writes memory_type=scan_complete. No uvicorn. Uses requests.post to write_service.
